secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID (optional — enables Google login). Get from Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret (optional — enables Google login). Get from Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name (optional — enables image uploads for avatars/KYC/statuses). Get from Cloudinary dashboard.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudinary API key (optional — enables image uploads). Get from Cloudinary dashboard.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Cloudinary API secret (optional — enables image uploads). Get from Cloudinary dashboard.

secrets.name: PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: PayPal REST API client ID (optional — enables coin purchases). Get from PayPal Developer dashboard (sandbox).

secrets.name: PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: PayPal REST API client secret (optional — enables coin purchases). Get from PayPal Developer dashboard (sandbox).

secrets.name: PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID
secrets.description: PayPal webhook ID (optional — verifies payment webhooks). Get from PayPal Developer dashboard.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_URL
secrets.description: LiveKit project URL (wss://<project>.livekit.cloud) — enables live video/audio streaming. Get from LiveKit Cloud console (https://cloud.livekit.io).

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_API_KEY
secrets.description: LiveKit API key — LiveKit Cloud console → project Settings → API keys.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
secrets.description: LiveKit API secret — LiveKit Cloud console → project Settings → API keys.

secrets.name: GMAIL_USER
secrets.description: Gmail address used to send live-stream email alerts to subscribers (optional — alerts are skipped until set).

secrets.name: GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: 16-char Gmail App Password for SMTP (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords). Optional — alerts are skipped until set.
